content.title: Proposed Business License Changes in Woodinville
content.summary: The City of Woodinville is considering updates to its business licensing regulations, including Ordinance No. 790 which limits grounds for denying or revoking a business license and establishes an appeal process, and Ordinance No. 791 which introduces new licensing requirements for massage and reflexology businesses. These changes will be discussed at the City Council meeting on August 5 at 7:00 PM.

steps.title: Review Proposed Ordinances
steps.text: Review Ordinance No. 790 and Ordinance No. 791 to understand the proposed changes to business licensing regulations in Woodinville.

steps.title: Attend City Council Meeting
steps.text: Attend the City Council meeting on August 5 at 7:00 PM where the proposed business license changes will be on the agenda for discussion and consideration.
